transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer support. My name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Craig. I'm calling about my broadband speed. I pay for the Fibre 75 package with a 70 megabit Stay-Fast Guarantee, but for the last three days I've been getting barely 12 megabits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that speed discrepancy for you, Priya. May I verify your billing address and your security question answer for account security?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 45 Parkside Gardens, Coventry, CV3 2NT. And the security question answer is my first pet, Jasper.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Priya, that verifies your account file. Now let's see what is happening with the speed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's been so frustrating trying to work from home. Video calls keep pixelating and dropping audio, and large file downloads take hours.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Getting only twelve megabits when you're paying for seventy is very frustrating, Priya, especially when you rely on stable video calls for work. Let's look into the line test immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Craig, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your broadband throughput has collapsed to approximately twelve megabits per second over the last three days, falling well below your seventy megabit minimum guarantee and causing video call drops. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will run the automated copper line diagnostic from our exchange console.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The line test completed. It shows a high resistance fault on the B-leg of the copper pair approximately three hundred meters from your property.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does a high resistance fault mean exactly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously high resistance faults occur when copper wire joints suffer rainwater corrosion or oxidation in an underground joint box, causing severe electrical signal attenuation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ah, we did have very heavy rain here on Sunday evening, so that matches when it started.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because this fault is situated on the external Openreach local loop, an Openreach engineer must be dispatched to locate and replace the corroded joint.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you book that engineer for me today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am opening the Openreach engineering booking portal to find available appointment slots.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, let me know what slots are available.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have found an engineer slot available for tomorrow between one PM and six PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow afternoon between one and six works perfectly for me. Do I need to be in the house, or can the Openreach technician carry out all the necessary diagnostics and splicing entirely from the street cabinet?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, an adult over eighteen must be present at the premises because the engineer will require access to test the master telephone socket inside your hallway to verify voltage and sync speeds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I work from home all day tomorrow, so I will definitely be present throughout that entire engineering window.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have confirmed and reserved the engineer appointment for tomorrow afternoon, Priya, and added notes to prioritize testing from your hallway test socket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I get an SMS notification before they arrive, so I know when they are pulling up outside?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the Openreach engineer will send an automated text message approximately thirty minutes prior to arrival at your property.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check, Priya, is your landline telephone handset operating with a clear dial tone right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the phone line has a dial tone, though there was a slight background hiss.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The slight hiss is consistent with the high resistance fault on the copper pair.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes total sense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because your speed dropped below the Stay-Fast Guarantee of seventy megabits, I have applied an automatic credit of fifteen pounds to your next monthly bill.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, thank you Craig! That is very fair and transparent customer service from S-Net to apply that discount automatically without me having to argue for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented the high resistance fault code and Openreach appointment reference number OR-882914 on your file, and applied the compensation credit immediately to your active ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me write that down: OR-882914. Thank you so much for ensuring all the job details and credits are in order.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the mobile number on file so the Openreach dispatch team can contact you if they arrive earlier.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my mobile number is 07700 900341.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have confirmed that contact number on the engineering dispatch notes, Priya.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wonderful. And what should I expect once the engineer finishes?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the copper joint is respliced, your Hub will automatically resynchronize with the cabinet DSLAM at full 75 megabit sync speed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will run a speed test as soon as they complete the job.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Remember to keep your Hub powered on continuously tonight so the dynamic line management system can monitor signal-to-noise ratio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll make sure nobody turns the power socket off overnight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We will also send an automated SMS follow-up once Openreach marks the engineering job completed on the exchange system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give me total peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you also access your S-Net mobile app to track real-time engineering progress tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have the S-Net app installed on my iPhone, I can see the Service Health tab.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will be able to see the engineer's estimated arrival time window update live on that screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very convenient for planning my working day around my meetings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you need emergency tethering data while the line is slow, we can also add a free ten gigabyte mobile data booster to your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that would be fantastic for my afternoon Zoom call with our international clients!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have provisioned that ten gigabyte emergency backup bundle right now, Priya.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Craig, that makes a world of difference for my work today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineering team will also have notes indicating our driveway gate entry code so they can park safely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the gate code is 4491, I will leave the outer gate open in the afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added that access instruction directly into the engineer job ticket, Priya.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if the engineer needs to replace the internal master socket faceplate as well?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Openreach technician carries NTE5C master sockets on their van and will replace the faceplate free of charge under our service guarantee.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is reassuring to know there are no hidden call-out charges.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All external line repairs and standard master socket replacements are fully covered by S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Craig, you have thought of everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your broadband service that I can help you with today, Priya?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thank you for booking the engineer so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a brief survey via SMS after this call; we would appreciate your feedback on the service provided today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll give you a positive score. Thank you, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Priya. Have a great day and goodbye.
